Combine control placement and decoration for a plate

compose_plate_decorator.Rd

Creates a decorator that first applies fixed control values and callback functions before delegating to an optional downstream decorator.

Usage

compose_plate_decorator(decorate = NULL, controls = NULL)

Arguments

decorate

Optional base decorator function.

controls

Optional list describing controls (see `annotate_plate_set()`).

Value

A decorator function accepting `(plate_df, plate_index)`.
